summary_en: Tennessine is a superheavy artificial chemical element with an atomic number of 117 and a symbol of Ts. Also known as eka-astatine or element 117, it is the second-heaviest known element and penultimate element of the 7th period of the periodic table. As of 2016, fifteen tennessine atoms have been observed: six when it was first synthesized in 2010, seven in 2012, and two in 2014.
summary_ko: Tennessine은(는) 미분류 원소로, 교육·연구·산업에 활용되는 기본 소재다. 상온에서는 이며 안전 지침을 따라 다루는 것이 권장된다.
